question: Richa Ghosh equalled which West Indies player’s record for the most sixes in a single Women’s World Cup edition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deandra Dottin.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Richa Ghosh equalled West Indies’ Deandra Dottin’s record for hitting the most sixes in a single Women’s World Cup edition — 12 sixes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Both Richa Ghosh and Deandra Dottin hit **12 sixes** in a single tournament.
 
• Richa achieved the feat during the **2025 ICC Women’s ODI World Cup.**
 
• Known for her explosive power-hitting in the middle order.
 
• Played key finishing roles in several Indian wins.
 
• Her performance added balance to India’s batting depth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Richa Ghosh’s Role:** Wicketkeeper-batter
 
• **Strike Rate (2025):** Over 120
 
• **Team:** India Women
 
• **Winner (2025):** India Women
 
• **Player of the Series:** Deepti Sharma
